capabilities: Convert LaTeX and Markdown in both directions
Export notes and folders to LaTeX
Diff notes block by block with formula awareness
Translate Chinese and English text locally
Manage a local llama.cpp translation server
extras: Desktop only; the translation feature manages a local llama-server process that mobile cannot run. All conversion, diffing, and translation run locally with no telemetry. The LaTeX parser is intentionally conservative and passes unsupported constructs through verbatim; Setext headings are not recognized.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to convert LaTeX to Markdown, compare notes with math-aware diffs, or translate academic text privately without cloud services.

relations.evidence: Powered by llama.cpp's llama-server: everything runs on your machine

requires.name: llama.cpp llama-server and a GGUF model (or an already-running llama-server)

summary: Academic-writing toolkit for LaTeX↔Markdown conversion, formula-aware note diffing, and local llama.cpp Chinese/English translation.
